deep_dive.executive_summary: At $10.67 (2026-08-20 close), the base case yields -34.4% per year over 7 years on normalized owner cash of $0.04 per share. Bitdeer scaled proprietary hash to 70.9 EH/s and $620 million of FY2025 revenue, but filing-based owner economics are thin once SEALMINER inventory distortion is removed. GAAP net income of $65.6 million is not repeatable owner cash because it embeds a $444.9 million fair-value gain on derivative liabilities. Marvin proposes watch until either price offers a mid-teens annual return on normalized owner cash or filings show durable hash-margin improvement plus contracte...

industry.structure: Bitcoin mining is a fragmented, power-intensive commodity industry where returns depend on bitcoin price, network hash rate, and electricity cost. Bitdeer differentiates with vertical ASIC integration (SEALMINER) and multi-line revenue (hosting, rig sales, AI cloud).
industry.share_shift: Bitdeer scaled proprietary hash from ~20 EH/s range (2023) to 70.9 EH/s by March 2026 while cloud hash rate revenue collapsed; competitors include public miners (MARA, CLSK, RIOT) and vertically integrated Asian operators.
industry.trend: Industry pivoting from pure mining toward AI datacenter conversion and proprietary ASIC supply chains; post-2024-halving economics compress margins when bitcoin falls 50%+ from peaks.
